# UDI manifest
metadata:
  udi: prismata.astalyzer.manifest.astalyzer
  name: ASTalyzer
  version: 0.2.0
  kind: manifest
  description: UDI manifest for the ASTalyzer prompt and API scanning tool.

udi: prismata.astalyzer.manifest.astalyzer
version: 0.2.0
kind: manifest
application: ASTalyzer

capabilities:
  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.capability.analyze-prompt-ticcseo"
    name: Analyze Prompt (TICCSEO AST)
    description: Parse a raw prompt string into a TICCSEO AST.
    inputs:
      - id: prompt_raw
        type: text
        required: true
    outputs:
      - id: prompt_ast
        type: object
        schema_id: "prismata.astalyzer.schema.prompt-ast-ticcseo"
        required: true

  - id: "prismata.astalyzer.capability.scan-api-recursive"
    name: Scan APIs (Recursive)
    description: Recursively scan a folder or file for external API usage.
    inputs:
      - id: root_path
        type: path
        required: true
    outputs:
      - id: api_report
        type: object
        schema_id: "prismata.astalyzer.schema.api-scan-report"
        required: true
    options:
      - id: include_internal
        type: boolean
        default: false
      - id: include_types
        type: boolean
        default: true

routing:
  engine: pcms2026
  mode: cli
  entrypoint: src/astalyzer/main.ts
